## Context
A clean local `rebar review-code` and a later `rebar review-plan` emitted repeated `rebar.llm.structured` warnings: `parse_structured: multiple candidates validated ...; selecting the LAST`. Logged first and last Pydantic models were semantically identical. The gates passed, but ordinary native structured replies were falsely classified as ambiguous.

## Confirmed root cause
For text containing exactly one JSON object, `_candidate_dicts` appends the same decoded dict from `_all_json_objects(text)` and again from `json.loads(text)`. `_select_and_validate` validates both into distinct Pydantic instances, then checks identity (`validated[-1] is not validated[0]`), which is always true for separately constructed instances even when equality and serialized values match. Runtime probe: one exact JSON reply produced `candidate_count=2`, `candidate_equal=True`, `validated_equal=True`, `validated_identical=False`. This is parser-generated duplication, not model text, provider envelopes, or retry aggregation.

## Plan
- Deduplicate semantically identical decoded candidate dicts in discovery order before validation.
- Preserve discovery order and last-valid-wins for genuinely distinct candidates.
- Add a RED warning-capture regression for an exact single-object reply and retain the existing conflicting-candidate warning/last-wins test as the negative control.
- Run focused structured-output, adapter, and review-kernel suites plus lint/typecheck.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] An exact one-object structured reply yields one semantic candidate and emits no multiple-candidate warning.
- [ ] Repeated semantically identical valid objects emit no ambiguity warning and return the same validated result.
- [ ] Distinct valid candidates still select the last and emit the ambiguity warning.
- [ ] Invalid/repair/sentinel and schema-filtering behavior remains unchanged.
- [ ] Focused structured-output and review gates pass.

## Testing
- `pytest tests/unit/test_structured.py tests/unit/test_pai_output.py tests/unit/test_review_kernel.py tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py -q` proves candidate selection, warning behavior, repair/sentinel parsing, adapter parity, and verifier integration.
- `make lint` and `make typecheck` prove formatting, complexity, and static-type gates.
